raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely asserted that “Education Of A Prince” was from the United States (based on Paramount/distribution) without verification, conflating distributor with country of origin. In reality, the identified films titled “Education of a Prince” (1927 and 1938) are French. This misinterpretation could have led to the incorrect conclusion that both films are from the same country.
